name: Said Mohamed Djohar
role: President of the Comoros from 1989 to 1995
contribution: A Comorian politician who served as the fifth President of the Comoros from 1989 to 1995.

checks.lead: Said Mohammed Djohar (Arabic: سعيد محمد جوهر 22 August 1918 – 22 February 2006) was a Comorian politician who served as the fifth President of the Comoros from 1989 to 1995.
